notes: Authoritative source: Extreme Networks official "ExtremeSwitching X440-G2" datasheet PDF (products.b-cdn.net/Brochures/Extreme_X440-G2_Datasheet.pdf), cross-checked against documentation.extremenetworks.com port/slot page. The 4 front-panel 1GBASE-X SFP ports are combo ports paired with RJ45 ports 21-24 (only one of each pair active at a time) — modeled here as the RJ45 ports' "accepts" plus a separate SFP entry is avoided by noting the combo relationship in this note rather than duplicating ports. The 4 rear-panel 1GBASE-X SFP ports are unpopulated and upgradeable to 10GbE SFP+ via software license (datasheet: "Maximum 10Gb SFP+ Ports: 4 via license") — graded here as sfp (bidirectional, no fixed grade since base is 1G and licensable to 10G; left ungraded per instructions since spec doesn't state a single fixed version, it's dual-capable 1G/10G depending on license and installed optic). RPS port is a coaxial barrel connector for an external Redundant Power Supply (RPS2000/RPS150), separate from primary AC input; modeled as dc-barrel, bidirectional-input for backup power. Primary power is a fixed internal supply with IEC 320 C14 inlet accepting an IEC 320 C13 cord (100-240 VAC, 50-60Hz). Console port is RJ45 (RS-232 serial over RJ45 with RTS/CTS), modeled as rj45 connector carrying RS-232 signaling (accepts rs232 noted). No USB port is listed for this specific 24t-10GE4 model in the datasheet's port table (USB 2.0 front-panel port is mentioned in general X440-G2 documentation for other/newer variants but not listed under this model's external ports/slots table, so omitted for accuracy).
